quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on his smartest play in college and the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think one time in college, I took a charge on an out of bounds during COVID.
quotes.quote: I think one time in college, I took a charge on an out of bounds during COVID. I thought that was pretty cool to get the ball back. In the NBA, I don't know if there's a lot of smart plays going on from Jalen. I would probably just say I've made a collection of smart plays as far as clock management, knowing exactly when to score to get two-for-ones.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on his physical recovery and offseason training
quotes.excerpt: getting my glutes and my hips to open up, I think took a lot of pressure off my hamstring.
quotes.quote: Me having hand surgery and not being able to do a lot of the stuff I usually do in the summer contributed to some of that. Usually when you have hamstring injuries and soft tissue stuff, it's usually something else isn't working. Getting my glutes and my hips to open up, I think took a lot of pressure off my hamstring. So now I feel very good, I feel very fluid. I feel back to what I think my normal is.

quotes.quote: Mario for sure, main character. But on this team, I feel like I'm more Luigi. But in life, I feel like I'm Mario. Everybody should feel like Mario in life.
